class.name: AgentSlate3D
class.brief_description: A held terminal object running a Claude Code session in the current room.
class.description: Put an [AgentSlate3D] under the player's camera. It renders a [SlatePanel] onto a quad through a [SubViewport]. Press the [member toggle_action] to raise it, type to talk, [code]ui_cancel[/code] to lower it. The session's working directory is the enclosing [Room]'s directory, or the project directory when there is no room. With [member attach_bridge] on, the session is launched with the OpenDust runtime MCP bridge attached (if [code].opendust/mcp-runtime.json[/code] exists in the project), so the agent inside the slate can act on the world through [code]world.*[/code], [code]agent.*[/code] and [code]os.*[/code] tools. Session ids are remembered per room and agent name in [code].opendust-slate.json[/code] so putting the slate down and picking it up resumes the conversation.

method.name: get_cwd
method.description: The directory the session runs in.

method.name: get_panel
method.description: The panel drawn on the screen: a [SlatePanel] unless [member panel_scene] is set.

method.name: start_session
method.description: Starts (or restarts) the Claude session. Called automatically on first raise when [member auto_start] is on.

members.member: Display name passed to Claude Code and used to key the remembered session id.
Passed as [code]--allowedTools[/code]. Empty means Claude Code's defaults.
Attach the OpenDust runtime MCP bridge so the agent can act on the world.

Optional model alias or name for the session.

Optional [code]soul.md[/code] appended to the session's system prompt.

signal.name: permission_requested
signal.description: The session asked for permission. If nothing is connected, the slate denies so the agent keeps moving.
